summary: Sabine Pass Liquefaction, LLC filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its Management Services Agreement and Operation and Maintenance Agreement to expand scope for constructing additional liquefaction trains at its Sabine Pass LNG terminal. The amendments, effective May 22, 2026, update existing service agreements between Sabine Pass Liquefaction, Cheniere LNG Terminals, Cheniere Energy Investments, and Cheniere LNG O&M Services. No financial terms, premiums, or board recommendations are disclosed. This is a routine operational amendment for capacity expansion, not a corporate transaction. Watch for regulatory filings related to the new trains.
